ConnectionArns.description: The ARNs of the connections that are members of the resiliency group. When specified, this is the complete, authoritative membership list: on update, connections not present are disassociated, and an explicit empty list removes all members. Omit the property to leave the existing membership unmanaged (unchanged on update). On create, an omitted or empty list means no connections are associated.
